description:
Current ability estimate for a learner from IRT calibration. One record per learner, key = "self" (updated in place each calibration run).
theta_u is on the logit scale. For reference:
  theta = -2: beginner (top ~2% of items accessible)
  theta = -1: elementary  
  theta =  0: intermediate (average, top ~50% of items accessible)
  theta = +1: advanced
  theta = +2: superior

This record supplements BKT knowledge-state tracking (bkt_param_fit_result): BKT tracks "what does the learner know?" while IRT tracks "how well can the learner perform?" — complementary signals.

learnerDid.description: The learner whose ability was estimated.

theta.description: Ability estimate on the logit scale. Range typically [-3, +3]. At theta=b_i, learner has 50% chance of correct response on item i.

seTheta.description: Standard error of theta estimate. Higher SE means fewer response observations or more inconsistent performance.

calibrationRunId.description: Links to the irt_calibration_run that produced this estimate.

updatedAt.description: When this ability estimate was computed (UTC).

numItemsAnswered.description: Total number of items the learner has responded to in this calibration run.

abilityBand.description: Broad ability band for UI display and adaptive routing. Mapping: beginner<-2, elementary<-1, intermediate<0, advanced<+1, superior>=+2 More precisely: band computed from theta distribution percentiles.

domain.description: Domain this ability estimate applies to. If null, this is an overall ability estimate. Domain-specific ability estimates allow cross-domain transfer learning.
